answers.core: This could improve accessibility for people who are new to Godot, especially for those who are used to working with other engines.
answers.workaround: As I've mentioned before, you _could_ hypothetically achieve this by creating multiple nodes and give them each a shader with different uniform variables, but this would not be very practical in the context of a dialogue system.
